invention.ref: Frank Honn invents the highlighter; Carter's Ink sells it as Hi-Liter
invention.ref_zh: 霍恩发明荧光笔，Carter's Ink 以 Hi-Liter 品牌出售

notes: 来源较弱：目前只有维基百科记载霍恩与 1963 年，公司所在城市未核实，地点仅标到国家。
summary_zh: 1963 年弗兰克·霍恩发明荧光笔，由 Carter's Ink 公司以 Hi-Liter 商标推出。
summary_en: Frank Honn invented the highlighter in 1963; Carter's Ink Company sold it under the Hi-Liter trademark.

notes_en: Weak sourcing: only Wikipedia documents Honn and 1963; the company's city is unverified, so the location is country-level.
